items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I knew Ethel Waters and Bessie Smith and Bruce and his grocery store.

ctx.x: Took you to the Lyric? Now how long were you at the Lyric?
Oh gee, about two years I guess, think because I knew Ethel Waters and Bessie Smith and Bruce and his grocery store.
What was that, a comedy thing?
